recipe.sql:
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CLOUD_GAUSSDB_INSTANCE) AS gaussdb_count,
    CASE
        WHEN (
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT logicalRegionId) FROM CLOUD_AZONE
            WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(logicalRegionId), '') IS NOT NULL
        ) = 1
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM CLOUD_AZONE
            WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(logicalRegionId), '') IS NULL
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM CLOUD_MIDDLEWARE
            WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(logicalRegionId), '') IS NULL
        )
        THEN (
            SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CLOUD_MIDDLEWARE AS middleware
            WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM CLOUD_AZONE AS azone
                WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(azone.logicalRegionId), '') IS NOT NULL
                  AND azone.logicalRegionId = middleware.logicalRegionId
            )
        )
        ELSE NULL
    END AS middleware_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CLOUD_OBS_BUCKET) AS obs_bucket_count
